titulo_de: Das ist doch der beste Plan
titulo_es: It's the best plan, isn't it?

besseres.es: mejor (neutro, comparativo delante de un nombre)
besseres.en: better (neutral, comparative in front of a name)

bloques.titulo: Superlative in front of the name
texto: In front of a name, the superlative is usually formed with **-st** or **-est** and is given the end of the adjective: **der beste Plan**, **die schönste Stadt**, **der heißeste Tag**. Some forms are irregular: **gut → besser → am besten / der beste**.
The comparative also declines: **ein besseres Ergebnis**.

**doch** (of course, then), **mal** (to see, a little), **ja** (already, as you know), **wohl** (probably), **aber** (what...!). They are used in the middle of the phrase and are not literally translated: **Das ist doch der beste Plan** (it is the best plan, of course!).
Eye with the false friend: **aber** as a particle does not mean «but», but «Wow!» or «What the hell!». And **wohl** is not «Good.»: it indicates supposition.

frases.de: Das ist doch der beste Plan!
frases.en: It's the best plan, of course!

frases.de: Komm mal her, ich zeige dir das Ergebnis.
frases.es: Ven a ver, te enseño el resultado.
frases.en: Come and see, I'll show you the result.

frases.de: Das ist ja ein besseres Ergebnis als gestern!
frases.es: ¡Vaya, es un resultado mejor que ayer!
frases.en: Well, that's a better result than yesterday!

frases.de: Er ist wohl zufrieden mit dem Plan.
frases.es: Probablemente está contento con el plan.
frases.en: He's probably happy with the plan.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «the best plan» in front of the name?

opciones.explicacion: Superlative in front of the name: beste.
«am» doesn't go in front of a name.
It's either accusative or dative, not nominative.

bloques.frase: Das ist ja ein besseres Ergebnis als gestern!

opciones.texto: It is with pleasant surprise that the figure obtained far exceeds the previous record.
opciones.explicacion: «ja» strengthens the palpable evidence of an objective improvement compared to the previous day.

opciones.texto: Lamenta el deterioro drástico de las métricas conseguidas en la última evaluación.
opciones.explicacion: It is diametrically opposed to the favourable comparative «besseres Ergebnis».

opciones.texto: He claims with regret that the current data are identical to those of yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: It denies the evidence of progress in comparison.

bloques.explicacion: It's bad to soften the order.

bloques.pregunta: How does «It's the best plan, of course!» express itself with a natural communication?

opciones.texto: Das ist doch der beste Plan!
opciones.explicacion: It uses the multimodal particle «doch» to highlight the evidence along with the attribute superlative «der beste Plan».

opciones.texto: Das ist wohl der am besten Plan!
opciones.explicacion: «wohl» denotes dubious supposition and the «am besten» form is not used admittedly to substantive.

opciones.texto: Das ist ja den besten Plan!
opciones.explicacion: The attribute subject after the copulative verb «sein» requires a non-accusative case («der beste»).

intro: Now two things: the superlative in front of the name and the modal particles. The particles give the phrase (surprise, doubt, mood) and are very typical of the German spoken.
